For CH224K, the input voltage on CFG2/CFG3 cannot be higher than 3.7V. For CH224D, the input voltage on CFG2/CFG3 cannot be higher than 5V.

In scenarios where back-end circuits, such as MCUs, exhibit slow startup or MCU pins default to a specific state, the CFG1 pin on the CH224K/CH224D may remain in a floating state or IO configuration mode until the MCU becomes operational. This could potentially trigger a 20V request. To mitigate this, if the system cannot tolerate a 20V input, it’s advisable to add a configuration resistor to the CFG1 pin. This ensures that the CH224K/CH224D can request an appropriate voltage by configuring the resistor before the MCU initialization process begins.

A capacitor (originally known as a condenser) is a passive two-terminal electrical component used to store energyelectrostatically in an electric field. The forms of practical capacitors vary widely, but all contain at least two electrical conductors (plates) separated by a dielectric (i.e. insulator). The conductors can be thin films, foils or sintered beads of metal or conductive electrolyte, etc. The “nonconducting” dielectric acts to increase the capacitor’s charge capacity. A dielectric can be glass, ceramic, plastic film, air, vacuum, paper, mica, oxide layer etc. Capacitors are widely used as parts of electrical circuits in many common electrical devices. Unlike a resistor, an ideal capacitor does not dissipate energy. Instead, a capacitor stores energy in the form of an electrostatic field between its plates.

When there is a potential difference across the conductors (e.g., when a capacitor is attached across a battery), an electric field develops across the dielectric, causing positive charge +Q to collect on one plate and negative charge −Q to collect on the other plate. If a battery has been attached to a capacitor for a sufficient amount of time, no current can flow through the capacitor. However, if a time-varying voltage is applied across the leads of the capacitor, a displacement current can flow.

An ideal capacitor is characterized by a single constant value for its capacitance. Capacitance is expressed as the ratio of the electric charge Q on each conductor to the potential difference V between them. The SI unit of capacitance is the farad (F), which is equal to one coulomb per volt (1 C/V). Typical capacitance values range from about 1 pF (10−12 F) to about 1 mF (10−3 F).

The capacitance is greater when there is a narrower separation between conductors and when the conductors have a larger surface area. In practice, the dielectric between the plates passes a small amount of leakage current and also has an electric field strength limit, known as the breakdown voltage. The conductors and leads introduce an undesired inductance and resistance.

Capacitors are widely used in electronic circuits for blocking direct current while allowing alternating current to pass. In analog filter networks, they smooth the output of power supplies. In resonant circuits they tune radios to particular frequencies. Inelectric power transmission systems, they stabilize voltage and power flow.

USB TO Parallel FIFO FT245 Module

The FT245BL provides an easy cost-effective method of transferring data to / from a peripheral and a host P.C. at up to 8 Million bits (1 Megabyte) per second. Its simple, FIFO-like design makes it easy to interface to any microcontroller or microprocessor via IO ports.

To send data from the peripheral to the host computer, simply write the byte-wide data into the module when TXE# is low. If the (384-byte) transmit buffer ?lls up or is busy storing the previously written byte, the device keeps TXE# high in order to stop further data from being written until some of the FIFO data has been transferred over USB to the host. TXE# goes high after every byte written.

When the host sends data to the peripheral over USB, the device will take RXF# low to let the peripheral know that at least one byte of data is available. The peripheral can read a data byte every time RXF# goes low. RXF# goes high after every byte read.

By using FTDI’s virtual COM port drivers, the peripheral looks like a standard COM port to the application software. Commands to set the baud rate are ignored – the device always transfers data at its fastest rate regardless of the application’s baud-rate setting.

Description: Are you a Java developer looking to add advanced hardware I/O capabilities to your Android or PC application? Well then the IOIO-OTG is for you! The IOIO-OTG (pronounced “yo-yo-O-T-G”) is a development board specially designed to do just that. It features a PIC microcontroller which acts like a bridge that connects an app on your PC or Android device to low-level peripherals like GPIO, PWM, ADC, I2C, SPI, and UART. An app-level library helps you write control code for these low level peripherals in the same way you’d write any other Java app!

What separates the IOIO-OTG from previous IOIO boards is the ability to leverage the USB On-The-Go specification to connect as a host or an accessory. There are several ways to connect the IOIO to your Java app. If the app is running on your Android device, the IOIO-OTG will act as a USB host and supply charging current to your device (meaning the IOIO-OTG will need its own power source). If your app is running on a Windows, Linux or OSX machine, the IOIO-OTG will assume device mode and present itself as a virtual serial port. When in device mode, the IOIO-OTG can be powered by the host! Connecting a USB Bluetooth dongle will cause the IOIO-OTG to show up as a Bluetooth serial connection so you can go wireless!

A switch on the board can be used to force the IOIO-OTG into host mode, but most of the time the board can be left in ‘auto’ mode and it will detect its role in the connection. We’re now shipping the IOIO-OTG board loaded with the V4.00 bootloader and the V3.30 application firmware. New application firmware is frequently released, and can be upgraded without needing a programmer using the IOIODude application.

The board includes a JST connector for attaching a barrel jack to JST connector and there are several pin headers broken out for voltage and ground access. A trimpot on the board allows you to adjust the charge current used when the IOIO-OTG is acting as a host. A USB-A to micro-A OTG cable is included which will let you connect your android device to the micro-USB port on the board using the cable that came with your android device.
Note: Please do not power your IOIO-OTG with 10V over longer wires. This may cause your board to fail.
Note: This product is a collaboration with Ytai Ben-Tsvi. A portion of each sales goes back to him for product support and continued development.

A centre-tapped transformer also known as a two-phase three-wire transformer is normally used for rectifier circuits. When a digital project has to work with AC mains a Transformer is used to step down the voltage (in our case, to 24V or 12V) and then convert it to DC by using a rectifier circuit. In a center-tapped transformer, the peak inverse voltage is twice as in a bridge rectifier hence this transformer is commonly used in full wave rectifier circuits.
How to use Center Tapped Transformer

The operation and theory behind a center-tapped transformer are very similar to a normal secondary transformer. A primary voltage will be induced in the primary coil (I1 and I3) and due to magnetic induction, the voltage will be transferred to the secondary coil. Here in the secondary coil of a centre-tapped transformer, there will be an additional wire (T2) which will be placed exactly at the center of the secondary coil, hence the voltage here will always be zero.

If we combine this zero potential wire (T2) with either T1 or T2, we will get a voltage of 12V AC. If this wire is ignored and voltage across T1 and T2 is considered then we will get a voltage of 24V AC. This feature is very useful for the function of a full wave rectifier.
Let us consider the voltage given by the first half of the secondary coil as Va and the voltage across the second half of the secondary coil as Vb as shown in the diagram below
As we know the voltage across the coil depends on the number of turns on the primary and secondary coil. Using the turns ratio formulae we can calculate the secondary voltage as:
Va = Voltage across the first half of Secondary coil
Vb = Voltage across the second half of Secondary coil
Vp = Voltage across the Primary coil
Na = Number of turn in the first half of Secondary coil

blocks.text: TOP234Y N-channel Power MOSFET Transistor 700V 2.4A TO-220-7B

The TOP234Y (TOPSwitch-FX family) combines a high-voltage, high-performance N-channel MOSFET with the controller, protection logic and startup circuitry on a single monolithic IC. This integration reduces external component count, improves reliability and enables designs with higher switching frequency (default 132 kHz, selectable 66 kHz in the Y package) and advanced features such as soft-start, frequency jittering, programmable current limit, line OV/UV detection and cycle-skipping for ultra-low no-load power.
The device supports robust protection (auto-restart, hysteretic thermal shutdown, SOA limits) and is specified for offline AC-DC flyback topologies and similar applications.
Integrated high-voltage N-channel MOSFET + PWM controller (single-chip solution).
Default switching frequency 132 kHz; 66 kHz selectable via FREQUENCY pin (Y package).
Fully integrated soft-start (≈10 ms) and frequency jittering to reduce EMI.
Programmable MULTI-FUNCTION (M) pin: OV/UV, line feed-forward/DCMAX reduction, external current-limit programming, remote ON/OFF, synchronization.
Cycle-skipping for very low no-load consumption (EcoSmart behavior).
On-chip protections: over-current, over-voltage, over-temperature (hysteretic), auto-restart, and safe-operating-area control.
Higher DCMAX (typical 78%) for improved power capability and smaller input caps.

blocks.v: Integrated off-line PWM controller with internal N-channel power MOSFET
Up to 700 V (DRAIN pin rating: −0.3 to 700 V absolute max)
132 kHz nominal (F tied to SOURCE); 66 kHz option (F tied to CONTROL)
Over-current, over-voltage (OV) shutdown, under-voltage (UV) detect, hysteretic thermal shutdown, auto-restart, SOA limiting
Up to ~75 W in open-frame with heat sink
TO-220 Y package provides increased DRAIN creepage; tab tied to SOURCE avoid tying tab to other nodes when heat-sinking
SOURCE (S): · Output MOSFET source connection for high voltage power return. Primary side control circuit common and reference point.

DRAIN (D): · High voltage power MOSFET drain output. The internal start- up bias current is drawn from this pin through a switched high- voltage current source. Internal current limit sense point for drain current.

CONTROL (C): · Error amplifier and feedback current input pin for duty cycle control. Internal shunt regulator connection to provide internal bias current during normal operation. It is also used as the connection point for the supply bypass and auto restart/compensation capacitor.

MULTI-FUNCTION (M): · Input pin for OV, UV, line feed forward with DC MAX reduction, external set current limit, remote ON/OFF and synchronization. A connection to SOURCE pin disables all functions on this pin and makes TOPSwitch-FX operate in simple three terminal mode (like TOPSwitch-II).
FREQUENCY (F): · Input pin for selecting switching frequency: 132 kHz if connected to SOURCE pin and 66 kHz if connected to CONTROL pin.

The X17-34-30A combines a standard NEMA 17 hybrid stepper motor with a 30:1 harmonic‑drive gearbox into a remarkably compact 60 mm‑long assembly. Retaining the familiar 42 × 42 mm flange and 34 mm stack, it delivers 2.2 N·m of continuous torque at just 1.4 A per phase. Unlike typical planetary gearmotors, its flex‑spline design achieves less than 2 arc‑min of backlash, providing ultra‑smooth, near‑perfect positional accuracy. This intrinsic precision eliminates mechanical “dead zones” and ensures repeatable motion under bidirectional loads.

Integrating the gearbox into the motor housing streamlines installation—no additional couplings or adapters are required—saving both space and assembly time. The effective output resolution of 0.06° further enhances trajectory smoothness without demanding extreme microstepping. With insulation class B, a maximum 80 °C temperature rise, and an ambient rating from –20 °C to +50 °C, the X17-34-30A is built for reliability. Its high torsional stiffness and minimal hysteresis make it ideal for robotic joints, precision rotary stages, and optical positioning systems. For any application where compactness, high torque density, and backlash‑free operation are paramount, this harmonic‑drive stepper offers a superior, ready‑to‑install solution.

The torque–speed curve for the X17‑34‑30A shows that at low speeds (up to about 300 RPM), the motor delivers its full rated torque between 2.2 N·m and 1.8 N·m, thanks to the harmonic‑drive gearbox maintaining near‑constant output. As speed increases from 300 RPM to 500 RPM, torque stabilizes at 1.8 N·m, reflecting the onset of electromagnetic and mechanical limits. Beyond 500 RPM, the torque falls more noticeably, reaching roughly 1.5 N·m at 800 RPM—still retaining over 68 % of its stall torque at high speeds. This profile highlights the X17‑34‑30A’s ability to provide strong, steady torque for precision, low‑speed positioning while maintaining substantial power well into its mid‑speed range for dynamic motion tasks.

The UNI-T UT171C is a robust, industrial‑grade True RMS digital multimeter designed for professional troubleshooting and maintenance in demanding environments. Designed for seamless integration into modern workflows, the UT171C comes equipped with a rechargeable 7.4 V, 2,000 mAh Li‑ion battery, USB and Bluetooth communication interfaces, and PC software (via CD) for data logging and analysis. When paired with the UT‑D07A Bluetooth adapter and the free “iDMM” smartphone app (available on Apple Store and Google Play), users can wirelessly monitor measurements in real time. Connecting 24C64 EEPROM IC to a Microcontroller/Microprocessor Unit
The EEPROM IC can be easily connected to an MCU/MPU. The diagram below can be referred to as the pinout and the connections of 24C64 to an MCU/MPU.

The 24C64 communicates via the I2C bus, so the SDA and the SCL pins are connected to the Data (I2C SDA) and clock(I2C SCK) line pin of the MCU/MPU, respectively. The SCA and SDA pins on the device are open rails so to make it work as normal pins you can also connect the pins to a pull-up resistor of 4.7K ohm and connect it to the VCC and then connect to your MCU.

The 3 pins A0, A1, and A2 form the address, so can be put to the ground. The WP/WC pin can be pulled down to the ground and the VCC and GND terminal of the 24C64 IC is to be connected to the VCC and Ground terminal of the MCU/MPU to power up the IC.

Note: You can connect the A0, A1, and A2 pins to either VCC or Ground. These 3 pins decide the logic of the slave device. If you connect them to the ground, the logic is 0 and when you connect it to VCC the logic becomes 1.

makers-369467.summary: Metal Oxide Varistor 680V 4.5 kA 14 mm for fast surge protection and voltage clamping in power circuits, safeguarding electronics from transient overvoltages.

blocks.text: The Metal Oxide Varistor (MOV) 680V 4.5 kA DISC 14 mm HEL-14D681K is a robust surge-protection component designed to safeguard electrical and electronic circuits from transient overvoltages such as spikes, surges, and inductive kickbacks. It is built with a disc-shaped ceramic body composed of zinc oxide grains mixed with other metal oxides, giving it highly nonlinear electrical characteristics. Under normal operating conditions, the varistor presents a high resistance, allowing regular current to flow with minimal leakage. However, when the voltage exceeds its threshold, the resistance drops dramatically and diverts excess energy away from sensitive circuitry.

This MOV has a nominal varistor voltage of 680 V, meaning it begins to conduct when voltage levels rise above this point, protecting components from damaging peaks. Its disc diameter of 14 mm enables a balance between energy-handling capability and compact size, making it suitable for many printed circuit board (PCB) applications. The radial leaded design allows straightforward through-hole mounting, which is common in both consumer and industrial equipment.

At the heart of its function is the ability to absorb high surge currents up to thousands of amperes in very short pulses and clamp the voltage to safer levels. When a transient event occurs, the MOV reacts within nanoseconds, protecting downstream electronics by shunting excess energy to ground. After the surge passes, it returns to its high-resistance state without interrupting normal operation. This makes the HEL-14D681K varistor an essential protective element in power supplies, control systems, and surge protector modules.

Tips: The main functions of a relay:

A relay is an automatic switch with an isolation function. It is widely applied to remote control, remote measuring, communication, automatic control, mechatronics, and electric or electronic devices as an important control component.
The relay has the following functions as a control component:

Expansion of control range: for example, when a multi-contact relay controls a certain number of signals, it could change over contacts, and close or open several circuits according to types of contact groups.
Amplification: for example, sensitive relay and intermediate relay use a tiny controlled quantity to control circuits of larger power.

Integration of signals: for example, when several control signals are input to a multi-wound relay in a specified form, they will realize the expected control effect after being compared and integrated.
Automation, remote control, and monitoring: for example, relays on automatic devices could form programmed control circuits with other devices to realize automatic operation.

blocks.text: Soldering Tin Paste is a mixture of powdered solder alloy and flux, designed to provide strong and reliable solder joints for electronic and electrical applications. It ensures efficient heat transfer, excellent wetting properties, and minimal residue after soldering. The paste is commonly used in surface mount technology (SMT), rework, and repair processes.
Solder Tin Paste allows for controlled and precise placement of solder on the PCB, which is especially important for small and densely-packed components.
The flux in the paste helps clean the surfaces, ensuring a strong, reliable electrical connection between components and the PCB.
Solder paste offers a more uniform heating process compared to other methods, reducing the likelihood of damage to sensitive components.
Lead-free solder pastes are available, supporting compliance with environmental standards like RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances).
It is easier to work with than traditional soldering wires or bars, making it ideal for automated processes.
Soldering paste is often more cost-effective for high-volume production compared to other soldering methods.
Solder pastes are generally composed of a metal alloy such as Sn (tin), Ag (silver), Cu (copper), and/or Pb (lead). Lead-free options are often based on alloys like SAC305 (96.5% Sn, 3% Ag, 0.5% Cu).
The paste has a specific viscosity that allows for easy application through stencils or syringes.
Flux is included in the paste to help remove oxidation from surfaces and improve the flow of solder.
The paste is formulated to melt at specific temperatures, typically around 183°C (for lead-free) or 183–190°C (for leaded solder) during the reflow soldering process.
Lead-free solder pastes have a melting point around 217–220°C.

Mechanically compact, the SW-520D is built for straightforward mounting and wiring; its two terminals allow direct connection to inputs or to simple conditioning circuits. Voltage regulators are very common in electronic circuits. They provide a constant output voltage for a varied input voltage. In our case the 78L05 IC is an iconic regulator IC that finds its application in most of the projects. The name 78L05 signifies two meaning, “78” means that it is a positive voltage regulator and “05” means that it provides 5V as output. So our 7805 will provide a +5V output voltage.

The output current of this IC can go up to 100mA. But, the IC suffers from heavy heat loss hence a Heat sink is recommended for projects that consume more current. For example if the input voltage is 12V and you are consuming 50mA, then (12-5) * (50*10^-3) = 0.35W. This 0.35 Watts will be dissipated as heat.

Another popular voltage regulator is 7805 which is bulkier in size but has high current rating of about 1A. So, if you are looking for a smaller package of voltage regulator that has small current rating in TO-92 package then this IC might be the right choice.

The 78L05 is a three terminal voltage regulator. The three terminals are Input, Output and ground as shown in the 78L05 pinout diagram. It is very easy and straight forward to use this IC, just connect the input in to the input voltage which has to be regulated and the ground pin to system ground.

In the circuit below a input voltage of 12V is regulated to 5V using the 78L05. You use the 5V to power any small loads like LED which is rated for less than 100mA. Because the maximum current that this IC could supply is only upto 100mA.

Also note the Capacitors C1 and C2 are used at both the Input and output end. These capacitors are used to filter any noise that’s coupled with the Input voltage. It’s not mandatory to use the exact value of capacitor but a value of 10uF for C1 and 1uF for C2 would be an ideal choice.

These regulators also have the ability to limit current and protect when the temperature exceeds beyond junction temperature. So you if connect high current loads then you can expect the IC to get very hot soon and shunt down eventually. In that using a high current regulator like 7805 would be an ideal choice.

Apart from using it as a voltage regulator it can also be used as a current regulator, short-circuit protector, booster circuit and even a variable voltage regulator. The circuits for all these applications can be found at page 27/45 in the 78L05 datasheet given below.

blocks.text: M&R Digital Electric Soldering Iron 60W 220V with Temperature Control

Digital Electric Soldering Iron 60W 220V with Temperature Control is a practical soldering tool designed for electronics repair, hobby soldering, PCB maintenance, wire tinning, component replacement, and general workshop use. The iron comes with a digital control handle, visible display area, adjustment buttons, a pointed soldering tip, and a direct power cord for easy operation without needing a separate soldering station.

This digital electric soldering iron is suitable for users who need a compact soldering tool with adjustable control and a replaceable tip system. It is designed for lead-free soldering work and everyday electronics repair tasks where stable heat, quick operation, and easy handling are important. The handle includes a small digital screen area with control buttons for increasing or decreasing the temperature setting, making it more practical than a fixed-temperature soldering iron.

The iron shown in the supplied images is marked as 60W 220V, making it suitable for direct connection to standard 220V power. Its power rating provides enough heat for common soldering applications such as joining wires, soldering through-hole electronic components, reworking small PCB points, tinning copper wires, and general maintenance jobs. The pointed tip shape helps the user reach narrow soldering points and work on small pads with better control.

The packaging indicates a lead-free longevity soldering process and a compatible soldering tips model system. The iron supports replaceable 936-style soldering tips according to the box information, which is useful because the user can change the tip shape depending on the job. A fine pointed tip is better for detailed work, while other compatible tip shapes can be used for wider joints, larger pads, or special repair work.

The tool includes a silicone power cord according to the packaging. Silicone cables are generally preferred in soldering tools because they are more flexible and more resistant to heat exposure compared with ordinary stiff cables. This improves movement on the workbench and helps reduce cable pulling during delicate soldering work. The box also mentions an inlet heating core and easy heating element replacement, which makes the design practical for maintenance and long-term use.

The handle is designed to be lightweight and easy to operate. The front section includes a metal sleeve and screw collar to hold the soldering tip securely. The red heat-insulation section and black handle body provide a clear grip area, while the rear strain relief helps protect the cable from sharp bending during use. The iron is suitable for electronics learners, repair technicians, makers, workshop users, and anyone who needs a direct-powered adjustable soldering iron.

كاوية لحام كهربائية ديجيتال ٦٠ وات ٢٢٠ فولت بتحكم في الحرارة

كاوية اللحام الكهربائية الديجيتال ٦٠ وات ٢٢٠ فولت هي أداة عملية مناسبة لأعمال صيانة الإلكترونيات، لحام الأسلاك، تركيب وفك المكونات الإلكترونية، إصلاح البورد، وتجهيز الوصلات الصغيرة داخل الورشة أو المنزل. تأتي الكاوية بتصميم مباشر يعمل بدون محطة لحام منفصلة، مع شاشة صغيرة وأزرار تحكم لرفع أو خفض درجة الحرارة، مما يجعلها أفضل من الكاويات التقليدية ذات الحرارة الثابتة.

هذه الكاوية مناسبة للمستخدم الذي يحتاج إلى أداة لحام خفيفة وسهلة الاستخدام مع إمكانية التحكم في الحرارة. تعتمد على قدرة ٦٠ وات وتعمل على جهد ٢٢٠ فولت، لذلك يمكن استخدامها في أعمال اللحام اليومية مثل لحام أطراف الأسلاك، تركيب المقاومات والمكثفات والمكونات الصغيرة، إصلاح نقاط اللحام الضعيفة، وتلحيم أطراف البورد في المشاريع الإلكترونية.

الكاوية تحتوي على طرف لحام مدبب يساعد على الوصول إلى الأماكن الضيقة والنقاط الصغيرة على البوردة. هذا الطرف مناسب للأعمال الدقيقة التي تحتاج إلى تحكم أفضل، مثل لحام أطراف المكونات الصغيرة أو تنظيف نقطة لحام قبل إعادة تثبيتها. كما أن العلبة توضح أن الكاوية تدعم أطراف لحام قابلة للتغيير من نظام ٩٣٦، وهذا يجعلها عملية لأن المستخدم يستطيع تغيير شكل الطرف حسب نوع الشغل.

وجود شاشة وأزرار تحكم على اليد يجعل الاستخدام أكثر مرونة. يستطيع المستخدم ضبط الحرارة حسب نوع القصدير وحجم نقطة اللحام بدلًا من الاعتماد على حرارة واحدة طوال الوقت. في الأعمال الصغيرة يمكن استخدام حرارة أقل لتقليل خطر تلف البوردة، أما في الوصلات الأكبر أو الأسلاك السميكة نسبيًا فيمكن رفع الحرارة حسب الحاجة مع الالتزام بالاستخدام الآمن.

سلك فصل شاشات منحني من ما أنت مقاس ٠٫٠٣ مم طول ١٠٠ متر

سلك فصل شاشات منحني من ما أنت مقاس ٠٫٠٣ مم طول ١٠٠ متر هو سلك رفيع جدًا مخصص لفنيين صيانة الهواتف لفصل الشاشات وقطع اللاصق بدقة، خصوصًا في الشاشات المنحنية والمناطق الضيقة حول الشاشة أو الغطاء الخلفي. يتميز السلك بقطر ٠٫٠٣ مم وطول ١٠٠ متر على بكرة منظمة، مما يجعله مناسبًا للاستخدام المتكرر داخل الورش ومراكز الصيانة.

هذا السلك من الأدوات الاستهلاكية المهمة في صيانة الهواتف، لأنه يساعد الفني على تمرير سلك رفيع داخل طبقة اللاصق لفصل الشاشة أو الغطاء الخلفي بطريقة أكثر تحكمًا. مقاس ٠٫٠٣ مم مناسب للأعمال الدقيقة التي تحتاج إلى سلك رفيع يدخل في الفواصل الضيقة بدون ضغط زائد على الشاشة أو الفريم.
يأتي السلك على بكرة بطول ١٠٠ متر، وبذلك يستطيع الفني قص الطول المناسب لكل عملية صيانة والاحتفاظ بباقي السلك منظمًا على البكرة. هذا يقلل التشابك ويسهل التخزين داخل درج الصيانة أو شنطة الأدوات.

الصور المرفقة توضح أن البكرة من ما أنت، ومكتوب عليها قطر ٠٫٠٣ مم ودرجة صلادة ٣٧٫٥، كما تشير المعلومات إلى أن السلك يتمتع بسطح ناعم ونظيف، ومقاومة شد عالية، ومتانة جيدة، مما يساعد أثناء عملية الفصل ويقلل احتمالية انقطاع السلك عند استخدامه بشكل صحيح.

سطح السلك الناعم يساعد على تقليل الاحتكاك أثناء المرور بين طبقات اللاصق. هذه النقطة مهمة جدًا في أعمال فصل الشاشات، لأن الحركة السلسة تقلل الضغط غير المطلوب على الشاشة أو الزجاج أو الحواف. ومع ذلك يجب استخدام السلك بحذر ومع تسخين مناسب حسب نوع الجهاز وقوة اللاصق.

يمكن استخدام هذا السلك في فصل شاشات الهواتف، إزالة الشاشات المنحنية، فصل الغطاء الخلفي، قطع طبقات اللاصق، وتجهيز الشاشات لبعض أعمال التجديد والصيانة. كما يمكن استخدامه مع مقابض شد السلك أو أدوات فصل الشاشة أو أجهزة التسخين المناسبة حسب طريقة العمل المتبعة في الورشة.

blocks.text: HW-508 Passive Buzzer Module 3-Pin Piezo Speaker Board

The HW-508 Passive Buzzer Module is a small and practical sound-generation module built around a passive piezoelectric buzzer. Unlike active buzzers that produce a fixed tone when powered directly, this passive buzzer requires an external control signal from a microcontroller or digital circuit, allowing the user to generate different tones, beeps, and simple sound patterns.

Because the module responds to a changing signal rather than a constant voltage, it is especially useful in projects where sound behavior needs to be programmable. By driving the signal pin with different pulse rates, the module can create audible tones and alert sounds suitable for many electronic systems. This makes it a popular choice for Arduino-based circuits, embedded systems, alarm indicators, educational electronics, and interactive devices.

Its compact board size allows it to fit easily into small projects, while the simple pin interface makes wiring fast and convenient. The module is commonly used in prototypes and finished products where an audible notification is needed, such as timers, counters, warning systems, toys, home automation devices, and user feedback systems.

The HW-508 module is also suitable for beginners who are learning microcontroller programming and sound control, since it provides an easy way to understand how digital signals can be used to generate tones through a piezoelectric element.

blocks.text: GA25-370 DC Gear Motor with Encoder 12V 130RPM 4.4kg.cm

The GA25-370 DC Gear Motor with Encoder 12V 130RPM 4.4kg.cm is a compact precision motor designed for projects that need both mechanical output and motion feedback. It combines a brushed DC gear motor with an integrated encoder, making it ideal for applications where speed monitoring, position feedback, and more accurate motion control are important.

This model operates at a nominal voltage of 12V DC and provides a free-run speed of 130RPM, which makes it suitable for controlled movement rather than high-speed rotation. The integrated gearbox helps reduce output speed while increasing torque, giving the motor the strength needed for robotics, smart motion systems, positioning mechanisms, and automation projects.

The built-in encoder makes this version especially useful in systems that require feedback for closed-loop control. It allows the controller to monitor shaft movement and rotation behavior more accurately, which is important in robotics, wheel odometry, synchronized drive systems, and motion control applications. This makes the motor much more suitable for intelligent projects compared with ordinary gear motors that only provide mechanical output.

The motor features a D-shaped output shaft for secure coupling with wheels, hubs, couplers, pulleys, and mechanical arms. Its geared design helps provide smooth and controlled rotation, while the encoder wiring expands its usability in advanced embedded systems and programmable automation projects.

This product is supplied as the motor with encoder and attached wires only. It does not include any mounting bracket or external holder. That makes it suitable for users who already have their own mounting solution or want to integrate it into a custom chassis or mechanism.

With its combination of moderate speed, useful torque, compact size, and encoder feedback, this motor is a strong option for builders who need reliable movement with better control accuracy in robotics and automation systems.

Wiring: Motor and encoder wires included

موتور جيربوكس جي ايه ٢٥-٣٧٠ بإنكودر ١٢ فولت ١٣٠ لفة في الدقيقة وعزم ٤٫٤ كجم.سم هو اختيار ممتاز للمشروعات التي لا تحتاج مجرد حركة فقط، بل تحتاج أيضًا معرفة السرعة أو الاتجاه أو عدد اللفات بدقة أعلى. لذلك فهذا النوع مناسب جدًا لتطبيقات الروبوت والحركة الذكية والأنظمة التي تعتمد على قراءة فعلية لحركة الموتور أثناء التشغيل.

الموتور يعمل بجهد اسمي ١٢ فولت تيار مستمر، ويعطي سرعة بدون حمل تصل إلى ١٣٠ لفة في الدقيقة، وهي سرعة مناسبة للتطبيقات التي تحتاج حركة متزنة وتحكم أفضل بدل السرعات العالية. وجود الجيربوكس الداخلي يساعد على تقليل السرعة ورفع العزم، وبالتالي يكون الموتور عمليًا في الأنظمة التي تحتاج قوة خرج مع ثبات في الأداء.

الميزة الأساسية في هذا الموديل هي وجود إنكودر مدمج، وهو المسؤول عن إعطاء إشارات راجعة يمكن استخدامها في متابعة سرعة الدوران أو اتجاه الحركة أو حساب المسافة واللفات في المشاريع الذكية. هذه النقطة مهمة جدًا في العربات الروبوتية، وأنظمة التوجيه، والميكانيزمات التي تعتمد على التحكم الدقيق، لأن الإنكودر يضيف طبقة من المتابعة والتحكم لا توجد في موتور الجيربوكس العادي.

الموتور مزود بعمود خرج على شكل دي، وده يسهل تثبيت الكوبلن أو العجلة أو أي جزء ميكانيكي بشكل ثابت ويقلل فرص الانزلاق أثناء التشغيل. كما أن أبعاده المدمجة تجعله مناسبًا للتركيب داخل شاسيهات الروبوت، ووحدات الحركة، وأنظمة الأتمتة الصغيرة والمتوسطة.
المنتج هنا يأتي بالموتور مع الإنكودر والأسلاك . وده مهم لأنه مناسب لمن لديه بالفعل قاعدة تثبيت خاصة به أو يريد دمجه داخل تصميم أو شاسيه مخصص حسب مشروعه.
إذا كان مشروعك يحتاج موتور جيربوكس بخرج ثابت مع إمكانية قراءة الحركة ومتابعتها بدقة أفضل، فهذه النسخة تعتبر مناسبة جدًا، خصوصًا في تطبيقات الروبوت والأنظمة التعليمية والتحكم في الحركة.

blocks.text: G86C1 Single Slot Li-ion Battery Charger for 18650 & 26650 Batteries

G86C1 Single Slot Li-ion Battery Charger for 18650 & 26650 Batteries is a compact and practical charger designed for charging one 3.7V lithium-ion rechargeable battery at a time. It is suitable for common cylindrical Li-ion cells such as 18650 and 26650 batteries, making it a useful charging accessory for flashlights, headlamps, portable devices, DIY electronics, small backup power tools, and workshop battery maintenance.

The charger features a simple single-slot design with a spring-loaded battery bay that holds the cell securely during charging. The polarity direction is marked inside the slot, helping the user insert the battery correctly before connecting the charger to power. Its compact body makes it easy to keep in a toolbox, electronics drawer, travel bag, or emergency kit.

Unlike integrated-cable versions, the G86C1 comes with a separate charging cable, giving the user more flexibility when connecting to a suitable 5V USB power source. It can be used with a wall adapter, laptop, power bank, car USB charger, or other stable USB power supply. The smart LED indicator provides a quick visual status check: red while charging and green when fully charged or standby, depending on the battery condition.

With 5V / 500mA input and 4.2V / 500mA output, this charger is designed for controlled, stable charging of compatible 3.7V Li-ion batteries. It is a simple and affordable solution for users who need a dedicated charger for one 18650 or 26650 cell without extra complexity.

microohm-214896.summary: SPS03N60C3 (03N60C3) CoolMOS N-Channel MOSFET rated for 600V and 3.2A, featuring ultra-low gate charge and fast switching in a compact TO-251 package—ideal for high-voltage switching and power supply stages. موسفت قدرة قناة إن بتقنية كول موس بجهد ٦٠٠ فولت وتيار ٣٫٢ أمبير، يتميز بشحنة بوابة منخفضة وتبديل سريع داخل تغليف تي أو ٢٥١، مناسب لمراحل التبديل في مزودات الطاقة ودوائر الجهد العالي.

blocks.text: SPS03N60C3 (03N60C3) CoolMOS N-Channel Power MOSFET – 600V 3.2A (TO-251 / PG-TO251-3-11)

The SPS03N60C3, commonly marked as 03N60C3, is a high-voltage CoolMOS N-Channel power MOSFET designed for efficient switching in compact power designs. It is optimized for fast switching performance with ultra-low gate charge, helping reduce switching losses and easing the requirements on gate driver circuits.

With a drain-source voltage rating up to 600V (and noted in some specifications as 650V at maximum junction temperature) and a continuous drain current of 3.2A, this MOSFET is a practical choice for high-voltage switching stages in power supplies, auxiliary converters, and similar applications. Its periodic avalanche capability and extreme dv/dt ruggedness support reliable operation under demanding transient conditions.
The device comes in a compact TO-251 (PG-TO251-3-11) package, making it suitable for space-efficient layouts while maintaining stable thermal and electrical performance.
Ultra-low gate charge (Qg) for efficient drive and reduced switching loss
Very fast switching behavior (low rise time)
Periodic avalanche rated for better robustness
Extreme dv/dt rated for improved reliability in fast switching stages

blocks.v: 600 V (some specs mention 650 V at TJ max)

blocks.text: ترانزستور قدرة موسفت قناة إن (كول موس) إس بي إس ٠٣ إن ٦٠ سي ٣ – ٦٠٠ فولت ٣٫٢ أمبير (تي أو ٢٥١)

القطعة إس بي إس ٠٣ إن ٦٠ سي ٣ والمعروفة بكود الطباعة ٠٣ إن ٦٠ سي ٣ هي موسفت قدرة قناة إن بتقنية كول موس مخصصة لدوائر التبديل ذات الجهد العالي مع كفاءة مرتفعة. تم تصميمها لتقديم أداء تبديل سريع مع شحنة بوابة منخفضة جدًا، مما يقلل فاقد التبديل ويسهّل قيادة البوابة في الدوائر العملية.

تدعم هذه القطعة جهدًا حتى ٦٠٠ فولت (ويُذكر في بعض المواصفات ٦٥٠ فولت عند أقصى حرارة للوصلة) مع تيار تشغيل مستمر يصل إلى ٣٫٢ أمبير، لذلك فهي مناسبة لمراحل التبديل في مزودات الطاقة، وحدات التحويل المساعدة، ودوائر التحكم ذات الجهد العالي. كما تتميز بقدرة تحمّل جيدة للنبضات والارتفاعات المفاجئة بفضل تصنيف الانهيار الدوري ومقاومة عالية لتغير الجهد السريع.
وتأتي في تغليف تي أو ٢٥١ المدمج، ما يجعلها مناسبة للتصميمات الصغيرة مع الحفاظ على استقرار الأداء الكهربائي والحراري.

blocks.text: Product Overview | نظرة عامة على المنتج

English: A compact, gasket‑sealed waterproof project enclosure sized 158 × 90 × 40 mm for housing electronics, power modules, and small IoT nodes. The box features a rigid body, a screw‑down lid with perimeter seal, and internal bosses for PCB mounting, making it ideal for field installations, sensor junctions, and DIY prototypes.

العربية: علبة مشاريع مقاومة للماء بغطاء يُثبت بالمسامير وحلقة إحكام محيطية، بحجم 158 × 90 × 40 مم مناسبة لحماية الإلكترونيات ووحدات الطاقة وعُقد IoT الصغيرة. تتضمن قواعد تثبيت داخلية للوحات PCB، ما يجعلها ملائمة للتركيبات الميدانية وصناديق التوصيل والنماذج الأولية.
✅ Water‑resistant sealed lid with a continuous gasket to help keep out dust and splashes (outdoor‑friendly when installed correctly).
✅ Rigid enclosure for impact resistance and long service life.
✅ PCB standoffs—multiple bosses inside for secure board mounting with self‑tapping screws.
✅ Cable‑entry friendly—flat sidewalls accept glands/conduits (drill to suit); smooth surfaces for labels.
✅ Compact footprint—fits control panels and tight spaces while still offering usable internal volume.
✅ غطاء محكم الإغلاق مع جوان محيطي لمنع الغبار ورشاشات الماء (ملائم للاستخدام الخارجي عند التركيب الصحيح).
✅ هيكل صلب يقاوم الصدمات ويوفر عمر خدمة طويل.
✅ قواعد تثبيت للوحات داخلية لتثبيت PCB بمسامير حفر ذاتي.

✅ حجم مدمج يناسب اللوحات الضيقة مع حجم داخلي عملي.
English: Environment‑exposed sensors, Wi‑Fi/LoRa nodes, power supply junctions, button/LED control stations, motor/relay interface boxes, marine and workshop projects, educational kits.
العربية: حساسات معرّضة للبيئة، عقد Wi‑Fi/LoRa، صناديق توصيل مزوّدات الطاقة، وحدات أزرار/لمبات، واجهات محركات وريليات، مشاريع بحرية وورش، وحقائب تعليمية.

English: The enclosure body and lid are injection‑molded from durable engineering plastic (commonly ABS; some batches may use ABS+PC). A silicone/foam gasket sits in a channel to seal the lid. Four (or more) stainless‑look screws secure the cover. Internal bosses accept M2.6–M3 self‑tapping screws (user‑supplied) for mounting PCBs or rails.

العربية: يُشكّل جسم العلبة والغطاء بالحقن من بلاستيك هندسي متين (غالبًا ABS؛ وقد تتوفر دفعات ABS+PC). توجد حشية سيليكون/فوم داخل مجرى لإحكام الغطاء. يثبت الغطاء 4 مسامير (أو أكثر) بمظهر ستانلس. تحتوي الداخل على قواعد تثبيت تقبل براغي ذاتي الحفر M2.6–M3 لتثبيت اللوحات أو السكك.

English: For best sealing, ensure the gasket is seated, surfaces are clean, and screws are tightened evenly. When adding cable glands, select IP‑rated glands and drill undersized pilot holes before tapping. For wall mounting, use external tabs (if present) or run screws through diagonal holes in the base; use stand‑offs to keep the PCB clear of mounting screws.

العربية: لضمان أفضل إحكام، تأكد من وضع الجوان بشكل صحيح ونظافة الأسطح وشدّ المسامير بشكل متساوٍ. عند تركيب جلب كابلات، استخدم جلبًا ذات تصنيف IP واحفر فتحات إرشادية أصغر قبل تثبيتها. للتثبيت على الحائط، استخدم ألسنة التثبيت الخارجية (إن وُجدت) أو ثقوب القاعدة، مع فواصل تباعد لتفادي ملامسة مسامير التثبيت للوحة.

blocks.text: DC-DC Step-Up (Boost) Converter Module — XL6009E1, 400kHz, up to 35V, up to 4A

If you need a compact XL6009E1 boost converter to raise a DC input to a higher regulated output, this module is the proven workhorse. It uses the genuine XL6009E1 controller at 400kHz with an integrated high-current switch, giving fast transient response and strong efficiency in a small footprint. Dial the multi‑turn trim pot to any target voltage within the supported range, and the board will hold regulation across varying loads when properly heatsunk and within limits.

Highlights at a glance: adjustable 5–35V output (module), typical up to 94% efficiency (load/conditions dependent), and up to 4A peak output capability (see notes). The onboard controller supports a wide input range at the IC level and exposes an EN pin internally; the module breaks out simple I/O pads for quick wiring.

🔎 Why this module? Compared with older 52kHz designs, the 400kHz XL6009E1 allows smaller inductors and capacitors, reducing ripple and board size. It also includes soft‑start, current limit, and thermal protection inside the chip.

Headroom & duty cycle: As Vout/Vin ratio increases, available output current drops. Plan with power balance and efficiency in mind: Pin ≈ Pout / η and Iin ≈ Pout / (Vin × η).
Thermals: For loads above ~15W, attach a small heatsink to the IC and provide airflow. Mount vertically for better convection.

Adjustment tip: Start with the pot fully counter‑clockwise and increase slowly while monitoring with a DMM.
Rule‑of‑thumb example: To get 12V @ 2A (24W) from Vin = 7V, at η ≈ 90%, expect Iin ≈ 24W / (7V × 0.9) ≈ 3.8A. Ensure your source can supply it.

blocks.text: CD4013 – Dual D-Type Flip-Flop with Set and Reset

The CD4013 is a dual D-type flip-flop IC, based on CMOS technology. Each flip-flop features independent Data (D), Clock (CLK), Set (S), and Reset (R) inputs, as well as complementary Q and Q̅ outputs. Data is transferred to the output on the rising edge of the clock signal. It’s widely used in digital systems for data storage, edge detection, frequency division, and toggle switch logic.

ekostra-29888.summary: DC Motor GW370 12V with Encoder 150 RPM 1. Voltage: 12V DC 2. Speed: 150 RPM (no-load) 3. Motor Type: DC geared motor 4. Encoder: Incremental quadrature 5. Frame: GW370

blocks.text: The DC Motor GW370 12V with Encoder is a brushed DC gearmotor delivering a no-load speed of 150 RPM at its rated voltage. It incorporates an incremental encoder that provides real-time feedback on speed and direction, making it suitable for applications requiring controlled motion and positioning accuracy. The integrated gearbox significantly increases the torque output, enabling it to drive heavier loads effectively.

This motor utilizes a quadrature encoder that outputs two digital signals (A and B). These signals are decoded by a microcontroller to determine the motor’s rotational parameters. The feedback mechanism is critical for implementing PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) controllers, which can maintain a constant speed despite varying loads. The GW370 frame is robust, ensuring reliable performance in demanding robotic and automation systems.
